how.title: From sign-up to *live*. No phone calls.

steps.title: Pick a plan
steps.text: Start your {trial_days}-day free trial. We need a card to start; the first charge comes when the trial ends.

steps.title: Sign up
steps.text: Your business, your hours, your common questions. 3 screens, saved as you go.

steps.title: Setup checklist

steps.title: Live
steps.text: Finish your checklist, turn on call forwarding and make one test call. We switch you live automatically, within 1 business day (Business plan: {days:FR_BUSINESS} business days).

trust.title: One monthly price
trust.text: No setup fee and no per-minute charges. Sales tax, where your state charges it, is added at checkout. We never charge you extra without your yes.

trust.title: No sales calls
trust.text: Sign up online in about 3 minutes. Cancel anytime in your online account. A video call is optional.

trust.title: A small studio
trust.text: {worked_with}. Your {assistant} runs on Claude, an AI made by Anthropic. Built with Claude; not affiliated with Anthropic, and not endorsed by it.

keep_number.q: Do I keep my business number?
keep_number.a: Yes. When you don't answer or the line is busy, your phone sends the call to the new number we set up (this is called call forwarding). Calls you pick up never reach it. Our setup checklist shows how for Verizon, AT&T, T-Mobile, Comcast Business, RingCentral and Google Voice.

cost.a: One monthly price, no setup fee. Starter is {price:FR_STARTER.monthly} a month with {minutes:FR_STARTER} voice minutes, Pro is {price:FR_PRO.monthly} with {minutes:FR_PRO}, and Business is {price:FR_BUSINESS.monthly} with {minutes:FR_BUSINESS}. Every plan starts with a {trial_days}-day free trial (up to {trial_minutes} minutes): we need a card to start, and the first charge comes when the trial ends. {minutes_text}

ai_disclosure.a: Yes. It introduces itself as your virtual assistant and never claims to be a person. The greeting says the call may be recorded and transcribed by us and our service providers, and that we may text the caller about it. Text messages to callers are switched off for now. If texting is turned on for your account later, it first asks the caller's permission to text a booking confirmation or reminder, and saves their answer. If a caller doesn't want to be recorded, it stops and keeps no written copy. We keep written copies of calls, never the audio.

no_call.q: Do I have to get on a call with you?
no_call.a: No. You pick a plan, sign up online in about 3 minutes, and finish a setup checklist with step-by-step instructions. If you want a 15-minute video call anyway, you can book one. It's optional.

timeline.a: 1 business day after you finish the setup checklist (your calendar, who gets alerts, and your business details). On the Business plan it takes {days:FR_BUSINESS} business days, because we set up CRM links and on-call dispatch with you.

cancel.q: Can I cancel? What if I'm not happy?
cancel.a: Yes, cancel anytime in your online account. Cancel during the free trial and you pay nothing. After that, your plan stops at the end of the month you paid for. {money_back} The details are in our Refund Policy.

who.a: A small studio that builds AI tools for local businesses, working remotely from {country}. {worked_with}. Built with Claude; not affiliated with Anthropic.

spanish.a: Yes, on the Pro and Business plans. Callers can talk in Spanish; your summaries stay in English.

builtin_ai.q: Why not the AI assistant built into Jobber or Housecall Pro?
builtin_ai.a: Built-in assistants are a good fit if you only need booking inside that app. Ours answers the phone itself, passes the caller to a person when needed, and a real person keeps it running. It works with Google Calendar, Calendly (with your own paid Calendly plan) and most apps through Zapier. On the Business plan we can also set up a direct link to HubSpot or Jobber for you, on request. Some systems (for example Outlook or ServiceTitan) need custom work, so ask us first.

hear_it.q: Can I hear it before I buy?
hear_it.a: Yes. Call {demo_phone}. It reaches our demo business, {demo_phone_business} in {demo_phone_city}, and the same AI {assistant} answers. It's a US number, so regular call charges apply, and the call may be recorded and written down as text. You can also try the text demo on this page.

missed.eyebrow: What happens to a missed call

usage_text_fallback: {usage_voice} minutes included every month. We let you know when you've used 80%. No surprise charges: we add more only if you say yes.
sms_note: Phone answering and email alerts work from day one. Text messages are switched off for now: business texting needs US carrier registration first. Alerts come by email.
